text: At e<=0.9, seed 70 is the only seed whose layer-4 accel_step R2 keeps rising after step 1000, and it does so on both data_seed 0 (+0.045) and data_seed 1 (+0.044). Is late accel_step growth a stable property of the model seed (init), and does a 6000-step seed-70 run level off below 0.45 on both datasets?
